summary: Silvercorp Metals filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a Canadian material-change/meeting notice) on September 30, 2026, announcing a further amendment to its Amended Articles Resolution ahead of its October 2, 2026 annual general and special meeting. The revision narrows Article 16 so the company may only request information expressly enumerated in Article 16, paragraph 4 from a nominating shareholder. The proxy deadline was extended to September 30, 2026, 4:00 p.m. Pacific. The board recommends voting in favor; any Hong Kong listing-related article replacement remains authorized but not required.
